about: Where text may sit, per format, in px from each edge. Photos and clips run full bleed; type stays inside. reel follows the Reels interface (top 14% for the header, bottom 35% for the caption and audio bar, the right edge for the action rail); feed is the 1:1 cut in the feed, where Instagram lays nothing over the post but the corners crop on the grid; portrait is the 1080x1350 card; story leaves the top bar and the reply field; square is a plain 1:1 still; wide is the 16:9 cut for YouTube and a laptop screen, with room left for a player's controls along the bottom.
